abilities.name: Lord Of Hatred
abilities.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Abilities reduces Mephisto's Basic Ability cooldowns. Skull Missile and Shade of Mephisto grant 1.5 seconds of cooldown reduction per Hero hit, and Lightning Nova grants 0.3 seconds per Hero hit.; trait

abilities.name: Skull Missile
abilities.description: Conjure a skull that travels in the target direction after 0.625 seconds, dealing 127 damage to enemies hit and Slowing Heroes hit by 25% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Lightning Nova
abilities.description: A ring of lightning appears around Mephisto for 2.5 seconds. Enemies within the ring take 43 damage every 0.25 seconds. Each time a cast of Lightning Nova hits a Hero, its damage is increased by 3%, up to 30%.

fields.notes: Mephisto's 4.5 Basic Attack Range is the same as the Lightning Nova's inner radius, meaning that AA move puts him at the correct distance. Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Lightning Nova 's damage.

abilities.name: Shade of Mephisto
abilities.description: Teleport to a location, dealing 78 damage to nearby enemies and leaving behind a Shade of Mephisto at Mephisto's original location. After 2.5 seconds, Mephisto is teleported back to the Shade's location.

fields.notes: Does not deal damage on return. The return always triggers regardless of any positive or negative status effects on Mephisto, with the exception of Stasis. The return teleport interrupts active displacements, but does not affect any other effects Mephisto may be afflicted by. However, with the right timing, certain displacements, such as Diablo's Overpower, may still continue their animation and snap Mephisto back to it after the return. Teleporting back dismounts and interrupts mounting, Hearthing and channeling objectives, but does not interrupt channeling Mephisto's Heroic Abilities or Warhead Junction's Nukes.

abilities.name: Consume Souls
abilities.description: Channel for 2.5 seconds, revealing all enemy Heroes. After the Channel completes, all enemy Heroes take 357 damage and are Slowed by 25% for 2.5 seconds.; 120; 80; heroic

fields.notes: Interrupting the cast puts the Ability on full cooldown.

abilities.name: Durance of Hate
abilities.description: After 1 second, unleash a wave of evil spirits that Root the first enemy Hero hit for 2.5 seconds and deal 250 damage to them over the same duration. Durance of Hate spreads outward from its initial target, Rooting and damaging additional nearby enemy Heroes.; 50; 50; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Damage over Time, Root, Skillshot
fields.notes: 1) The area grows in increments of 0.5625 radius every 0.1875 seconds, reaching its maximum radius after 2.0625 seconds. Interrupting the Ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown. If Mephisto teleports back with Shade of Mephisto during the cast time, the wave is unleashed in the direction of target point. Enemies that are immune to skillshots cannot be hit by the initial missile, but can be affected by the spreading area, as long as they are not also immune to AoE.

talents.name: Unyielding Power
talents.description: Quest Hit Heroes with Skull Missile. After hitting 20 Heroes, increase Skull Missile's damage by 100. Reward After hitting 40 Heroes, Skull Missile gains an additional charge.

fields.notes: Bonus damage is added to base damage and dealt in a single instance.

_raw_fields: Quest Hit Heroes with Skull Missile. After hitting 20 Heroes, increase Skull Missile's damage by 100. Reward After hitting 40 Heroes, Skull Missile gains an additional charge.

talents.name: Furious Spark
talents.description: Every 3rd hit from Lightning Nova against the same target deals 65 bonus damage and grants Mephisto 2 Mana.

fields.notes: Bonus damage is dealt in an additional instance. Damage from Furious Spark does not benefit from Lightning Nova 's innate damage multiplier nor create stacks for it.

_raw_fields: Every 3rd hit from Lightning Nova against the same target deals 65 bonus damage and grants Mephisto 2 Mana.

talents.name: Malicious Intent
talents.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 25% Spell Power while active and for 2.5 seconds after ending. If Mephisto hits enemy Heroes at least 18 times with his Basic Abilities while Shade of Mephisto is active, then increase the duration of the Spell Power bonus to 10 seconds after it ends.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself. Subsequent applications refresh the duration if it is currently lower than 2.5 seconds. Spell Power stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting Mephisto's Spell Damage or healing output.

_raw_fields: Shade of Mephisto grants 25% Spell Power while active and for 2.5 seconds after ending. If Mephisto hits enemy Heroes at least 18 times with his Basic Abilities while Shade of Mephisto is active, then increase the duration of the Spell Power bonus to 10 seconds after it ends.

talents.name: Hateful Mending
talents.description: Skull Missile grants 10 Mana and heals Mephisto for 70% of the damage it deals to Heroes.

fields.notes: Mana restoration triggers for each enemy Hero hit.

_raw_fields: Skull Missile grants 10 Mana and heals Mephisto for 70% of the damage it deals to Heroes.

talents.name: Static Barrier
talents.description: At the end of its duration, Lightning Nova grants Mephisto a Shield equal to 40% of the damage it dealt to Heroes. Lasts 5 seconds.

fields.notes: Shield amount is calculated similarly to Lifesteal from final damage dealt. Bonus damage from Furious Spark, Static Field, Aminosity and secondary Nova from Mimic all contribute to Shield amount gained. Gaining a Shield from Static Barrier while already having one causes them to stack and refreshes the duration.

_raw_fields: At the end of its duration, Lightning Nova grants Mephisto a Shield equal to 40% of the damage it dealt to Heroes. Lasts 5 seconds.

talents.name: Spite
talents.description: Increase Regeneration Globe healing duration by 100%. Every tick of Regeneration Globe healing activates Lord of Hatred, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second.

fields.notes: Makes Regeneration Globes tick an additional 5 times, healing Mephisto for an additional 9% of his maximum Health and an additional 7% of his maximum Mana over its duration.

_raw_fields: Increase Regeneration Globe healing duration by 100%. Every tick of Regeneration Globe healing activates Lord of Hatred, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second.

talents.name: Ghastly Armor
talents.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 25 Armor while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Shade of Mephisto grants 25 Armor while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends.

talents.name: Frost Storm
talents.description: While Shade of Mephisto is active, enemies who are hit by Lightning Nova are Slowed by 15% for 1 second and the Slow from Skull Missile is increased to 50%.

fields.notes: Shade of Mephisto must be active the moment Lightning Nova or Skull Missile hits the target (not when the Ability is cast) to benefit from this talent.

_raw_fields: While Shade of Mephisto is active, enemies who are hit by Lightning Nova are Slowed by 15% for 1 second and the Slow from Skull Missile is increased to 50%.

talents.name: Trickery
talents.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 20% Movement Speed while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends. If Mephisto hits enemy Heroes at least 18 times with his Basic Abilities while Shade of Mephisto is active, then reset the cooldown of Shade of Mephisto.
_raw_fields: Shade of Mephisto grants 20% Movement Speed while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends. If Mephisto hits enemy Heroes at least 18 times with his Basic Abilities while Shade of Mephisto is active, then reset the cooldown of Shade of Mephisto.

talents.description: Cooldown 120 Channel for 2.5 seconds, revealing all enemy Heroes. After the Channel completes, all enemy Heroes take 357 damage and are Slowed by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

talents.description: Cooldown 50 After 1 second, unleash a wave of evil spirits that Root the first enemy Hero hit for 2.5 seconds and deal 250 damage to them over the same duration. Durance of Hate spreads outward from its initial target, Rooting and damaging additional nearby enemy Heroes.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 50 After 1 second, unleash a wave of evil spirits that Root the first enemy Hero hit for 2.5 seconds and deal 250 damage to them over the same duration. Durance of Hate spreads outward from its initial target, Rooting and damaging additional nearby enemy Heroes.

talents.name: Abhorred Skull
talents.description: Hitting a Hero with Skull Missile grants 25% Spell Power for 6 seconds. Skull Missile deals 40% more damage to Heroes under 50% Health.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier / Offensive damage modifier
fields.notes: Spell Power from Abhorred Skull does not stack with itself. Subsequent applications refresh the duration. Spell Power from Abhorred Skull stacks additively with other sources of Spell Power and other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting Mephisto's Spell Damage or healing output. Damage bonus against low-Health Heroes stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Skull Missile 's damage.

_raw_fields: Hitting a Hero with Skull Missile grants 25% Spell Power for 6 seconds. Skull Missile deals 40% more damage to Heroes under 50% Health.

talents.name: Hysteria
talents.description: Lord of Hatred also reduces the cooldown of Mephisto's Heroic Ability. Mephisto is healed for 15% of his maximum Health and Mana when he casts his Heroic Ability.
_raw_fields: Lord of Hatred also reduces the cooldown of Mephisto's Heroic Ability. Mephisto is healed for 15% of his maximum Health and Mana when he casts his Heroic Ability.

talents.name: Shard of Hate
talents.description: Basic Attacks hit enemies near the primary target and activate Lord of Hatred against enemy Heroes, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second per Hero hit.
_raw_fields: Basic Attacks hit enemies near the primary target and activate Lord of Hatred against enemy Heroes, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second per Hero hit.

talents.name: Lightning Reaction
talents.description: Skull Missile explodes on contact with Lightning Nova, dealing 120 damage to nearby enemies.

fields.notes: Lightning Reaction can trigger multiple times on the same cast.

_raw_fields: Skull Missile explodes on contact with Lightning Nova, dealing 120 damage to nearby enemies.

talents.name: Static Field
talents.description: When Lightning Nova's damage bonus reaches 30%, enemy Heroes within its radius take damage equal to 10% of their maximum Health.

fields.notes: Bonus damage is dealt in an additional damage instance.

_raw_fields: When Lightning Nova's damage bonus reaches 30%, enemy Heroes within its radius take damage equal to 10% of their maximum Health.

talents.name: Animosity
talents.description: Increase the duration of Lightning Nova by 1 second and the maximum amount of bonus damage it can deal from 30% to 42%.
_raw_fields: Increase the duration of Lightning Nova by 1 second and the maximum amount of bonus damage it can deal from 30% to 42%.

talents.name: Consumed by Hatred
talents.description: Consume Souls deals bonus damage equal to 10% of the target's missing Health. If Consume Souls initial cast kills a Hero it will cast 1 additional time.

fields.notes: The bonus damage amount is calculated before the main damage is dealt. Free cast does not require channeling. Recast will trigger if a Hero (not including Hallucinations) dies to any source within 0.5s of being hit by Consume Souls.

_raw_fields: Consume Souls deals bonus damage equal to 10% of the target's missing Health. If Consume Souls initial cast kills a Hero it will cast 1 additional time.

talents.name: Unspeakable Horror
talents.description: Durance of Hate Silences enemies while they are Rooted and for 3 seconds after its Root expires.

fields.notes: If a target is hit by a Knockback while affected by this Ability, the Silence and Root are both temporarily removed, and then both reapplied when the Knockback applies. Because the target is necessarily Dazed during the Knockback, this rarely matters, but the reapplication of the Silence could matter for certain CC removal Abilities (e.g. Brightwing's Soothing Mist, Lunara's Abolish Magic).

_raw_fields: Durance of Hate Silences enemies while they are Rooted and for 3 seconds after its Root expires.

talents.name: Mimic
talents.description: While both Shade of Mephisto and Lightning Nova are active, Lightning Nova also casts from the Shade's location.

fields.notes: Shade's Lightning Nova interacts with all Talents that affect Lightning Nova.

_raw_fields: While both Shade of Mephisto and Lightning Nova are active, Lightning Nova also casts from the Shade's location.

talents.name: Shade Lord
talents.description: Cooldown 20 Activate to swap locations with Shade of Mephisto and refresh its duration. Passive Shade of Mephisto benefits from all of Mephisto's level 7 Talents.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 20 Activate to swap locations with Shade of Mephisto and refresh its duration. Passive Shade of Mephisto benefits from all of Mephisto's level 7 Talents.
